diagnosticVariants.name: hud-hidden-compositor-isolation
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides the DOM HUD shell to isolate CSS/compositor cost; not a gameplay or quality fix.

diagnosticVariants.name: hud-flight-layer-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides only the always-mounted flight HUD layer, leaving root/screen shells intact.

diagnosticVariants.name: root-nonhud-overlays-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides non-HUD root overlays to isolate always-mounted compositor shells.

diagnosticVariants.name: control-hints-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides the flight control hint bar to isolate its blur/shadow/fade compositor cost.

diagnosticVariants.name: control-hints-effects-off
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: keeps the hint bar present while stripping blur/shadow/transitions from that one overlay.

diagnosticVariants.name: dock-fade-overlay-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides the docking fade overlay to catch inactive fullscreen transition-layer cost.

diagnosticVariants.name: inactive-fullscreen-shells-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides modal/vignette/boot fullscreen shells to catch faded-but-composited layers.

diagnosticVariants.name: hud-radar-target-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides the radar/target right-dock layer to isolate canvas and target compositor cost.

diagnosticVariants.name: hud-radar-only-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides only the radar canvas/legend wrapper to isolate radar redraw/compositor cost.

diagnosticVariants.name: hud-target-panel-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides only the target readout panel to isolate target DOM/compositor cost.

diagnosticVariants.name: hud-radar-effects-off
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: keeps the radar visible while stripping CSS shadows/filters/transitions from the right-dock radar layer.

diagnosticVariants.name: hud-bottom-cluster-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides the bottom status/action layers to isolate text/stat compositor cost.

diagnosticVariants.name: hud-top-nav-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides mission/nav/objective overlays to isolate top-HUD text and arrows.

diagnosticVariants.name: hud-reticle-overlays-hidden
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: hides reticle/lock/damage/floating overlays to isolate per-frame HUD markers.

diagnosticVariants.name: ui-effects-off-diagnostic
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: removes expensive HUD shadows/filters/animations to isolate compositor effects; not a visual-quality fix.

diagnosticVariants.name: webgl-submit-noop-diagnostic
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: skips WebGL render submissions to isolate scene update/sim from GPU present cost; not a visual-quality fix.

diagnosticVariants.name: sim-paused-render-only
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: pauses simulation so remaining frame time is render/GPU/UI/present work.

diagnosticVariants.name: bloom-off-straight-render
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: disables the post bloom path to measure post-processing cost; not a quality-preserving fix.

diagnosticVariants.name: bloom-post-grade-off
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: keeps bloom enabled while stripping grain/vignette/color-grade from the composite shader.

diagnosticVariants.name: bloom-grain-off
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: keeps bloom/grade/vignette enabled while stripping the animated grain sample.

diagnosticVariants.name: render-graph-on-diagnostic
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: routes through the authored render graph to compare post pipelines; not a settings/default change.

diagnosticVariants.name: sim-paused-bloom-off
diagnosticVariants.note: Diagnostic only: pauses simulation and skips bloom together to isolate base scene/render submission cost.
